name: l2_owner_timer_init

provenance.source: Exact IDB uv_timer_init (type 13 at +8, flags 8 at +44), same address as .155; evidence/owner-pump.json

notes: Owner pump only (no L2 transport on this target): the resident 88-byte, 8-byte-aligned timer that keeps background timers firing with the screen off. Mutates the owner loop; call only from the LVGL bootstrap on that same UI task, never from NSH, BT or ISR. No production approval.
